summary.text: Mike McKell is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 25 in Utah County, serving since January 1, 2013, and is the Senate Majority Assistant Whip. The Legislature's roster lists him as an attorney and title officer.

paragraphs.text: McKell earned a B.A. from Southern Utah University and a J.D. from the University of Idaho, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.

The roster lists him as an adjunct professor at Utah Valley University and a board member of the Spanish Fork Chamber of Commerce and Spanish Fork Kiwanis, and notes that he was named to Utah's Legal Elite in 2011 and 2012.
